players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

strengths.title: Tackle timing
strengths.note: Wins the ball cleanly and rarely gets beaten in the duel.
strengths.coach: When you went in, you came out with the ball. That's timing.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: 27 passes but no key passes - plenty of the ball, little going forward
weaknesses.title: Playing forward
tips: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
weaknesses.coach: Plenty of the ball, but not much going forward. Let's hurt 'em with it.

players.headline: Strong midfielder performance (8.1, top 25% for the position) - best at on-ball involvement, tackle timing; work on playing forward.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: Now that's what I'm talking about, BellyTb1. A 8.1 puts you in the top quarter of midfielders.
coach.closer: Proud of you. Now go drink some water.

push.title: L 1-2 vs West Cumberland | You: 8.1 (top 25% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.1 against West Cumberland. That's top-25% midfielder work, and it didn't happen by accident.

DID WELL
+ 27 passes (up from your usual 19). The team ran through you like a highway through a small town.
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 22%). You were patient as a fisherman, then struck.
+ 1 assist. You set the table and let everybody else eat.
+ Every time you found PhogsToffees, something good happened.
+ You hit 8.1, top 25% for a midfielder.

WORK ON
- No key passes from 27 passes. Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- Pass accuracy: 85%. The bar for top midfielders is 87%+. Go clear it.
- Tackles attempted: 3. The next level is 6+.
- Lost to West Cumberland 1-2. We'll study it, then forget it.

Homework: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.

That's the player I knew you were. - Coach Lasso
